2026-04-06: Rose has heated argument with Arjun Dev on phone (06:12 call) where Arjun says 'You'll regret pushing me away'. Later that day Rose visits Dr. Shalini Clinic in Anna Nagar for anxiety, prescribed Alprazolam 0.5mg x10. Prescription becomes source of sedative.

2026-04-07 to 2026-04-10: Meera holds two private sessions (08 Apr and 10 Apr, 17:00 and 10:30). In sessions Meera asks Rose to repeat 'I trust you' and uses breathing/suggestion. Rose feels scared/pressured but struggles to say no. She writes deleted note 10 Apr 16:22 'Don't know how to say no to Meera... felt scared after' then deletes it.
2026-04-09: Arjun unexpectedly appears at Rose's client meeting in Nungambakkam (Brew Room), showing pattern of monitoring/pressuring.
2026-04-10 16:20: Vikram Rao visits Green View Apartments to see friend Priya Menon in Flat 2A (same building as Rose). This is innocent but will later look suspicious on CCTV.
2026-04-11 22:14: Arjun sends message to Rose 'You'll regret ignoring me, Rose. You can't just cut me off like this.' Rose forwards screenshot to Ananya, expressing fear.

2026-04-12: Rose argues with Vikram at Besant Nagar studio about karma; Vikram says 'Karma will catch you if you play with energies you don't understand' (philosophical, not threat). Rose pays Vikram Rs1,500 for art print Beach Series #042 (invoice VR-042) — transaction will later be misinterpreted as occult payment.

2026-04-13: Rose spends day at Marina (payment Rs380), receives missed call from Meera at 20:05 (Meera will later deny), has argument call with Arjun 20:30. Night 22:10-22:18 she searches 'alprazolam alcohol interaction' and 'how much is dangerous' — she is anxious about medication, researching interaction out of worry, not forming definitive suicide plan yet. She deletes a message to Ananya at 22:45 ('if anything happens...' per Ananya's recollection).

2026-04-14 09:15-10:18: Rose messages Ananya 'Feeling very low, didn't sleep', tells Meera she needs time alone, tells Arjun 'please give me space'. She is sleep-deprived (3h sleep) and overwhelmed. Last long call with Ananya at 14:05 (03:44), last outgoing message to Ananya at 15:12 thanking her.

2026-04-14 15:18: Rose last unlocks phone. Between 15:30 and 16:45, alone in Flat 3B (door latched from inside, no forced entry), Rose self-administers Alprazolam (2-3 tablets, from the 4 missing plus possibly loose tablets) mixed into orange juice with a small amount of alcohol (≈15ml ethanol, source unclear but not brought by intruder — likely from a small bottle she had, not logged in purchases). She does this intentionally under acute distress and sustained coercive pressure, but ambivalence remains — note 'I can't keep doing this. It's too much. Sorry. — R' was written earlier that day or previous night as a draft, not prominently placed, reflecting distress rather than formal suicide note.

2026-04-14 16:16-16:22: Arjun Dev is in fact near Anna Nagar (CCTV 16:16 medium, phone ping 16:18) having come to buy an apology gift at Crossword (Anna Nagar branch) between 16:00-16:30 (cash payment, no receipt, store CCTV inconclusive). He does NOT enter Flat 3B and does NOT administer substances. His presence is coincidental to death window but creates apparent opportunity. The blurred stairwell figure at 16:20 is a motion artifact/ghosting from low FPS, not a person entering Rose's flat.
2026-04-14 16:20-16:45: No other person enters Flat 3B. Toxic effects lead to CNS depression and death between 15:30-17:30. No struggle, body found supine.
2026-04-14 18:14: Ananya calls Rose (missed), 18:28 arrives with manager, discovers body 18:30. Police arrive 19:05.

2026-04-15 to 2026-04-18: Investigation reveals alibi contradictions (Arjun T. Nagar claim vs Anna Nagar ping/CCTV; Meera Adyar 18:00 claim vs Nungambakkam 18:20 CCTV) but neither person was in flat at ingestion. Meera's 12:45 GPS movement toward Nungambakkam was for grocery/errand, not Anna Nagar.
actual_cause_of_death: Acute mixed central nervous system depression due to self-administered Alprazolam (benzodiazepine) and ethanol toxicity; ingestion via partially consumed orange drink (E-003). Synergistic effect fatal at individually sub-lethal doses. Superficial hand/wrist marks are old, not causative, unrelated to mechanism.
responsible_person_if_any: Rose Mathew (self-administration); no direct homicide. Primary contributory factor is sustained coercive control/harassment by Arjun Dev and, secondarily, psychological pressure via suggestive sessions by Meera Krishnan, which increased vulnerability but did not involve direct administration or supernatural mind control.
intentional_or_accidental: Intentional self-harm under sustained psychological distress and coercive influence; classified as undetermined/suicide-leaning. Evidence leans toward intentional (note, searches, recent stress) but accidental misjudgment of interaction cannot be fully excluded. Ground truth models it as intentional self-harm facilitated by coercive context, not accidental overdose and not third-party homicide.
